items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: I brought the whole big band to play the opening of Roland Kirk in that place.

ctx.x: I said, “Now this is what we’re going to do.” I said, “I’m going to have a list of tunes for you and we’re going to go over them tonight. We’re not going to go over them, I’m going to show you how they go and how we’re going to do it and what you need to do and when you need to stop playing each tune and start playing the next one. So you know we did that and they — you know little blips here and there. I did a dance program with one of those with a jazz dance thing. I said, “Well we’re going to play these tunes…
